mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/wire-format.md <<'EOF'
# Wire format

The project's current recorded decision is to use CBOR (Concise Binary Object Representation) as the message serialisation format. It was chosen because it handles type information better across protocol versions, which suits a system whose data schema evolves over time and needs forward and backward compatibility.
EOF
cat docs/policies/wire-format.md

The decision comes from the project's recorded decision log, not from the code. The repo still ships msgpack binding and render code (`binding/msgpack.go`, `render/msgpack.go`), and I found no CBOR code, so the code doesn't yet reflect the decision.
